# Nyarindo Lens Universal

> Nyarindo Lens Universal is the portfolio and linked browser projects of Newbon Nyarindo Gadson: writer, consultant, designer, builder, and full-stack developer. The central creative framework is The Nyarindo Lens, a way of noticing pulse, container, relationship, attention, and return.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio home](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/): Author profile, selected work, books, and the full theory sequence.
- [The Lens of Everything](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/lens-of-everything.html): A working description of reality as process and regulation.
- [A Legion Wearing One Face](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/a-legion-wearing-one-face.html): An illustrated theory of personhood, archetypes, meetings, and myth.
- [The Threshold Rule of Communication and Morality](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/the-threshold-rule.html): A lens for communication, dissent, repair, and fidelity.
- [Peace Pon Eye and Eye](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/peace-pon-eye-and-eye.html): A prayer-lens of peace, attention, contradiction, and connection.
- [When Science and Faith Share a Bench](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/science-and-religion.html): A conversation about evidence, faith, curiosity, and attention.
- [The Aperture](https://nyarindolens.com/portfolio-website/the-aperture.html): The final theory, presented as a four-act play and key artwork.

## Browser projects

- [Drift](https://nyarindolens.com/drift/): A human-curated music discovery app built on official source links, visible provenance, and a private local Playground for albums, playlists, lyric timing, local media, themes, and karaoke preparation.
- [Drift artist lane](https://nyarindolens.com/drift/artist.html): A rights-first workspace preview for verified identities, batches of official music sources, reversible public permission, and quiet listener updates.
- [Return](https://nyarindolens.com/memory-app/): A private, device-local journaling and returning practice.
- [Semantic Field](https://nyarindolens.com/semantic-field-extension/): A browser-based semantic mapping prototype.

## Nyarindo Library

- [The Nyarindo Library](https://nyarindolens.com/books/): Read all seven books, the general introduction, the end note, and the combined collection in a theme-aware browser reader; download the PDF editions; or convert a private PDF into the same reader locally on the device.
- [Particles in conversation](https://nyarindolens.com/books/experiments/particles.html): A live attraction-and-repulsion experiment from the companion code.
- [Fields that remember walls](https://nyarindolens.com/books/experiments/fields.html): A bounded particle field exploring constraint, clustering, and equilibrium.

## Usage notes

- The theory pages are presented as authored frameworks, stories, and observations rather than settled scientific claims.
- Page content and project descriptions are suitable for indexing and retrieval.
- Private journaling entries are stored only in the visitor's browser and are not available to crawlers.
